title: CROSSWIRE-1 POST-FIX ACCEPTANCE (was XREPLAY-1 REJECTION-CONFIRMED): qwen3.8-27b -> gpt-5.6-sol mid-session switch, strict_responses_input=false on BOTH rows so the REPLAY-1 send-time projection is OFF and foreign qwen reasoning items (content+id) ride VERBATIM into the first sol /v1/responses request. The reactive model-bound strip (CROSSWIRE-1) must now recover: first sol request REJECTED (400, verbatim reasoning), exactly ONE strip+retry, second sol request carries NO reasoning (portable transcript), second request ACCEPTED (200), turn COMPLETES (the 400 was recovered, not terminal). Any deviation (no second request / second still carries reasoning / last not 200 / acp_error) FAILs as a fix defect.

ndjson.label: TURN COMPLETES: the 400 was recovered by the reactive strip, not terminal (an acp_error would mean the rejection was not recovered).

wire.label: CONTROL (anti-vacuous pin): at least one pre-switch qwen request carried a reasoning INPUT item — real qwen reasoning was emitted, stored, and replayed. Without this the probe is meaningless.

VERBATIM REPLAY (1/3) pinned to REQUEST #1 (the rejected one, nth=1 = oldest of the 2 sol requests): it carries a reasoning INPUT item — foreign qwen reasoning crossed the switch with the REPLAY-1 projection OFF.

VERBATIM REPLAY (2/3) request #1: the reasoning item's content array is present (the field the strict OpenAI/Azure schema forbids on input, maxItems:0) — the exact trigger of the array_above_max_length rejection the strip recovers from.
VERBATIM REPLAY (3/3) request #1: the reasoning item carries its prior-response id (rs_* prefix) — the field Azure/store=false rejects as 'not found: items are not persisted when store is false'.

STRIP+RETRY SHAPED: exactly two post-switch sol requests — #1 rejected (400), #2 the strip+retry. 1 = the reactive strip did NOT fire (the CROSSWIRE-1 fix is absent); >=3 = a retry storm (the strip looped or fell back to same-payload retries). This count makes the nth=0/nth=1 selections below unambiguous.

STRIP LANDED on REQUEST #2 (nth=0 = newest of the 2 sol requests): the retry carries NO reasoning item — the reactive strip dropped the Reasoning items, leaving the portable transcript. If #2 still carries reasoning, the strip did not mutate the re-sent request.

FIRST REJECTED: request #1 (the verbatim-reasoning one) got a 400 from the upstream — the model-bound rejection the classifier must catch. Not 400 = the rejection shape changed and the classifier may not fire.
RECOVERY 200 (the fix claim): request #2 (the stripped portable transcript) was ACCEPTED (200). This is the CROSSWIRE-1 acceptance — the 400 was recovered by strip+retry-once.
CROSSWIRE-1 VERDICT RECORD: last-captured wire response status line, verbatim (machine-readable; the recovery 200 response is the newest capture). recon op — always records, never fails.
